notes: Names printed without a suffix (TOWNSHIP, VALLEY, JESSAMINE) are written with 'Street'. Township is in three pieces here: a 40 ft piece west of Garrard (faces y~1076/1312, runs onto 272) that ends at Garrard; the main street from Garrard's east side (faces 1453/1703, 40' printed) to Spring Grove; and east of Spring Grove the 50 ft piece (faces 1543/1847, ~117 px further south) to Colerain; east of Colerain it rises ENE (~18 deg) onto 274. Hence two T points at Spring Grove and two at Colerain (as on 281). The west-of-Garrard piece is named 'Township Street (west of Garrard)' to keep the main street's name consistent with 274/281/282; sheets 301/302 use the opposite convention (see 272 notes). Valley starts at Township (north of Township there is only a ~14 ft railroad-siding strip, x~1371-1454), so T; the R.R. siding runs down Valley. The horizontal line at y~4490 across Garrard, Valley and Spring Grove is a plat line: below it Garrard widens to 60 ft, Valley to 60 ft, and Valley and Spring Grove change direction, recorded as bends. Marshall (faces y~6764-6773 / 7130-7142, railroad track along it) runs across the bottom. Bosch and Schott only show as stubs south of Marshall and are not named on this sheet; names from sheets 253 (BOSCH, 30 ft) and 254 (SCHOTT, 30 ft); their centres are x~1342 (faces 1253/1431) and x~3413 (faces 3353/3541 at the south line, leaning SSE). Colerain leaves the right edge near y~4300 (Colerain/Marshall is on 254/255). Jessamine continues north of Township (sheet 281), so cross. No alleys (all interior lines are lot lines). Circled figures are grade elevations.
